title: Brewlog - Brew it again

style.notes: Warm, cosy, flat illustration, rounded cards with thick outlines and hard shadows, faint grid.

guardrails: No ratings, user counts or awards that the brief does not give.

scenes.goal: Every cup is a little different and you forget what worked.
scenes.visual: Flat-vector pour-over dripper over a mug on a cream, faintly gridded background. Three mugs in a row with slightly different steam swirls and a small danger-coloured question mark above each. The kicker pill sits top, the headline below in big serif.
scenes.narration: Every cup is different. What worked?
sound: soft warm whoosh as the mugs slide in
gentle drip tick as the question marks pop

scenes.goal: Brewlog logs a brew in three taps.
scenes.visual: A rounded phone-sized card with a thick outline and hard shadow rises in. Three chunky tap targets light up in turn in the accent colour: beans, grind, ratio and time as mono-labelled rows filling in one by one, with a finger dot tapping each.
scenes.narration: Brewlog logs a brew in three taps.
sound: rising tick as rows fill in

scenes.visual: The log card flips to a rating row: five outlined stars fill left to right in the warning colour as a stamp-style saved pill lands beside them. The stars are decorative shapes with no number or score.

scenes.goal: Brewlog shows which recipe you liked best.
scenes.visual: Three recipe cards stack as a list; two slide down and dim while one slides to the top, grows, and gains an accent-coloured BEST badge with a small coffee-cup icon. Recipe rows are shapes only, no figures.
scenes.narration: And it shows your best recipe.
sound: warm two-note chime when BEST badge lands

scenes.goal: Brew it again: go to brewlog.example.
scenes.visual: Plain cream end card with the faint grid. The headline in big serif and an accent-coloured pill with the link, both on thick-outlined cards with hard shadows, and a steaming mug icon that settles beneath.
scenes.narration: Brew it again. Brewlog dot example.
sound: music resolves to one held chord
